text: 你们顺利经过“分水之地”，抵达西支流较平缓的水道。如今食物充足，临近麦克唐纳堡时，你们逐渐恢复体力。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 593
text: You pass the “place of splitting water” with no particular difficulty and reach the calmer waterways of the West Branch. The foraging is ample now, and you recover strength as you draw near to Fort McDonald.
